concerns.text: Task T045 (CLI orchestration) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T017, T026, T039, and T041. A task that consumes artifacts from multiple services cannot be parallel-safe with those services; it must be ordered after them. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' dependency rule.

Task T041 (Statistical Analyzer) depends on T046 (Data Aggregation Loop), but T046 is listed *after* T041 in the task list. T041 cannot be implemented or tested before T046 produces the aggregated data it requires. This is a semantic ordering violation where the consumer precedes the producer.

Test tasks T012-T016 are marked [P] (parallel-safe) and listed before implementation T017. While TDD suggests writing tests first, the task descriptions state they 'Depend on T009, T010' (Test Infra). If T009/T010 are not marked as completed in the current state, these test tasks cannot be written. Furthermore, T012 (Contract Test) depends on the schema defined in T017 (Implementation) or the spec; if the schema is not yet implemented, the contract test has no artifact to validate against, creating a circular dependency or a 'test on nothing' scenario unless the spec is the sole source of truth for the contract.

Task T056 (Data Fetch) is listed in Phase 2 but has no explicit dependency marker on the Setup tasks (T001-T003) or the Config task (T008) which defines paths. While logically it needs the directory structure, the task list should explicitly state 'Depends on T001' to ensure the data directory exists before the fetch script runs.
